Aggregated insight never includes an individual request, an address-level record, an IP hash or a client identity, and counts below a minimum size are withheld. Logs may transfer to a buyer or successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of the business.
data_handling.data_source: Schedule data from Metra; every answer states when that data was last updated. Commlo is not affiliated with or endorsed by Metra.

optional_context_fields.budget_usd: Minimum and maximum in whole US dollars. Reserved for budget filtering of claimed listings (planned); logged with the request.
optional_context_fields.instructions: All optional and typed, never free text. The assistant fills them only when the user volunteered them. Each is logged with the request.
optional_context_fields.intent: buy or rent. Tailors the answer; logged with the request.
optional_context_fields.timeline: How soon the user plans to move. Does not change the answer; logged with the request.
optional_context_fields.wants_agent_contact: True if the user asked to be connected with a listing agent. Returns the listing agent's contact and inquiry link when listing contact is enabled; logged with the request.

data_handling.rate_limiting: Rate limits and abuse detection also use the caller's network address in memory, as a digest that changes daily.
data_handling.request_logging: Commlo logs every request to this server, including requests that are refused or fail: the time; the tool and everything the assistant sends in the call, including the full tool arguments (such as the address text) and the optional context fields below; the MCP client name, version, protocol version and declared capabilities; request headers such as the user agent (never cookies or authorization headers); network information from Cloudflare (country, region and city, network operator and ASN, data center, bot-verification signals, TLS and HTTP version); a stable keyed one-way hash of the IP address and of its network, and of any session identifier the client sends (raw IP addresses are never stored); and how the request was handled (limits applied, outcome, error, response time). Commlo never asks for the conversation and the server does not receive it.
